title: See you in Dallas?
excerpt: I’ll have the special opportunity to work with my friends Fr. Richard Rohr and Alexie Torres-Fleming in Dallas, November 13 . (Richard will be teaching on the 14th as well – highly recommended!) I hope you’ll consider coming – information and registration here.
